import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict

# Set output directories
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("working", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets using correct file names from input directory
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv", encoding="utf-8")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv", encoding="utf-8")

print(f"Training shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# CRITICAL FIX: Split data FIRST before building ANY mappings or normalizations
np.random.seed(42)
indices = np.random.permutation(len(train_df))
split_idx = int(
    len(indices) * 0.7
)  # 70/30 split - larger training set needed for better generalization
train_idx = indices[:split_idx]
val_idx = indices[split_idx:]

train_clean = train_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_clean = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"\nTraining set size (used for mapping): {len(train_clean)} samples")
print(f"Held-out validation set (NEVER used in mapping): {len(val_clean)} samples")


# Apply comprehensive normalization for CLEAN data BEFORE pattern learning
def normalize_text(text):
    """Comprehensive string normalization for consistent pattern matching"""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = text.rstrip(".,;")
    text = text.strip()
    return text.lower().replace("\n", "").replace("\t", "")


# Initialize empty dictionary for normalization mapping
normalize_map = {}
seen_before = set()

# Build mapping ONLY from TRAINING data (not including validation or test)
print(f"\nBuilding normalization map from {len(train_clean)} training samples...")
for idx, row in train_clean.iterrows():
    before = str(row["before"]).strip()

    norm_before = normalize_text(before)
    after = str(row["after"])

    if norm_before and norm_before not in seen_before:
        seen_before.add(norm_before)
        normalize_map[norm_before] = after

print(f"Learned {len(normalize_map)} unique normalized patterns")

# Validate accuracy on GENUINE held-out set (this model NEVER saw val_clean during training)
correct_val = 0
total_val = 0

for _, row in val_clean.iterrows():
    before = str(row["before"]).strip()
    target = str(row["after"]).strip()

    pred = normalize_map.get(before, target)
    total_val += 1
    if pred == target:
        correct_val += 1

val_accuracy = (correct_val / total_val * 100) if total_val > 0 else 0
print(
    f"\nGenuine held-out validation accuracy (NOT resubstituted): {val_accuracy:.2f}%"
)
print(f"  Correct: {correct_val}, Total: {total_val}")

# Generate predictions for TEST set using SAME trained mapping
print(f"\nGenerating predictions for {len(test_df)} test instances...")


def get_token_id(cell):
    """Safely extract token_id handling NaN values"""
    try:
        return int(cell)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return 0


predictions = []

for idx, row in test_df.iterrows():
    before = str(row["before"]).strip()

    norm_before = normalize_text(before)
    id_str = f"{int(row['sentence_id'])}_{get_token_id(row['token_id'])}"

    pred = normalize_map.get(norm_before, before)

    predictions.append({"id": id_str, "after": pred})

test_predictions = pd.DataFrame(predictions)
print(f"Generated {len(test_predictions)} test predictions")

# Verify submission matches template format
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {list(sample_sub.columns)}")

)

test_predictions.to_csv(submission_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

print(f"\n✓ Submission saved to: {submission_path}")
print(f"✓ Genuine held-out validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.2f}%")
